tenderSchedule.title: Providing External painting, Internal Painting to Corridors, Repairs to plastering, Chejja repair work, Replacement of Damaged Rain Water Pipes, Preventing Leakages in Damped Walls and other allied civil works for LH-2,1st Stage, Legislators Home, Bengaluru.
tenderSchedule.description: Providing External painting, Internal Painting to Corridors, Repairs to plastering, Chejja repair work, Replacement of Damaged Rain Water Pipes, Preventing Leakages in Damped Walls and other allied civil works for LH-2,1st Stage, Legislators Home, Bengaluru.
tenderSchedule.locationName: PWD No.1 Buildings Division Office Bengaluru

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
The intending tenderer is instructed to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW K.P.W.D. and further orders there on.
All necessary drawings, paper works, etc. and any other formalities required to be observed shall be the responsibility of contractor
Whenever executing authority insist proof of having purchased the materials (used during executing the work) for verification. The contractor has to produce the purchase bills.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Blore dated 01.01.07 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.07, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund
Condition 11: Conditional tenders are not accepted.

The tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed format from the competent Authority Executive Engineer (District level Officer) and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file Certificate/ Certificates, which shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification
Financial year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and thirty first day of March inclusive
The employer reserves the rights to reject one or all tender without assigning any reason.
Tenderer shall note, that the tenderers those found Eligible to the conditions mentioned in Section-3 Qualification Instructions to Tenderers (ITT) will only be considered for further evaluation
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E- procurement portal

All the items includes all Leads and Lifts, Loading and Unloading, transportation charges, Cost of all materials, Labour, HOM of machineries as per Standard specifications and as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work and all other incidental items which are necessary for the successful completion of the work
The bidder should be a reputed company registered as a Class III and above Civil Contractor with PWD, Govt. of Karnataka and should have suitable technical, financial & managerial capabilities
The contractor shall not deviate/alter/execute excess quantities or additional items without the prior approval
The Cost of the tender form shall not be refundable
Further particulars, if any, required by the contractor can be had from the O/o the Executive Engineer, No.1 buildings Division during office hours.
Agency Should upload Employees provident fund (EPF) & ESI registration certificate, and also should upload copy of receipt of the last six months for the payment made for the same
The Tenderer should submit Latest GST clearance certificate
The quantities shown in the schedule are approximate. The actual quantities will be executed as per site condition only. Any balance materials shall be taken back by the contractor.
Tenderer should be registered in labour department & submit labour registration certificate
Tenderers must provide the address with valid proof of address along with latest photographs of all the employees who are employed in this work to the concerned authority
Tenderers must provide insurance to all the employees executing this work.
The Labours deployed shall mandatorily wear the face mask, hand gloves and take all safety measures to protect labours and staff

Bidder should upload the bid capacity calculated as per KW-2 tender condition, The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent. False representations in the statements leads to disqualification of the tender as per clause 3.1
The Quoted Rates Shall be Excluding GST

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.2 To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2020-21 to 2024-25 b)Satisfactory completion as prime contractor in Similar of Civil Engineering works to an extent of 50% of the cost of the work i.e. Rs 14.98 Lakhs

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2020-21 to 2024-25 a)Achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs. 29.96 lakhs

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available tender capacity (AxNx2.5-B) Where A is Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N is Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited 10 month. B is Value, at 2025-26 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 10 month. Note The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing External painting, Internal Painting to Corridors, Repairs to plastering, Chejja repair work, Replacement of Damaged Rain Water Pipes, Preventing Leakages in Damped Walls and other allied civil works for LH-2,1st Stage, Legislators Home, Bengaluru.

itemList.description: Removing white wash or colour wash by steel brushing and / or scraping, sand papering and preparing wall surface smooth including repairs to scraches including cost of labour, material complete as per specifications.
Dubbing out on old irregular walls average 10mm thick and making good the surface with cement mortar 1:4 including curing cost of materials, labour, complete as per specifications.

Crackfilling - Providing Waterproof treatment to the cracks using 1 coat of bondcoat of  SBR  latex  and  Cement  at  the  ratio  1:1  and  then  preparing  Cement Mortar of 1:3 admixed with SBR latex at a dosage of 15% of Cement. SBR latex confirming to BS 6319 part 2:1983 & ASTM C 190-85. Cure for 5 days. Apply singlecomponent, cold applied, water based acrylic and UV resistant water proofing & protector conforming to ASTM D 412-1992 & ASTM E 1980-01. The surface shall be prepared free of dust, fungus, loose & hard particles etc.. The cracks are sealed with crack x-shrink free sealing paste as per direction of Engineer in charge.

Repairs to plaster in patches of 2.5 m2   and less in walls, ceilings 10 to 20mm thick in cement mortar 1:3 including cutting the patches in proper shape and replastering the surface of the wall including disposal of rubbish with a lead of 50m including curing cost of materials, labour, complete as per specification.

Treating mild Dampness in Interior walls - Providing and Applying Acrylic Co Polymer single component specially designed waterproof protective coating that prevents damp patches on walls without any dilution at rate of 0.25kg/m2 in 2 coats to achieve total dry  film  thickness  of  170  microns  DFT.  The  material  having  followed technical properties: crack bridging ability up to 1mm as per EN 1062, Tensile strength ≥ 2N/mm2 as per ASTM D 412, adhesion strength 1.5N/ mm2 as per ASTM D4541. The finished cost including surface preparation completely as per specification.

Providing  and  applying  white  cement  based  putty  of  average thickness 1  mm,  of   approved   brand   and   manufacturer,   over   the  plastered wall   surface   to prepare the surface even and smooth complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge.

Applying    priming    coats    with    primer    of    approved    brand    and manufacture,   having   low  VOC   (Volatile   Organic   Compound) content. With  ready  mixed  pink  or  grey  primer  on  wood work  (hard and  soft wood) having VOC content less than 50 g/L as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge.
Removing the old paint from steel and / or other metal surface with hand scraping and making surface even including cost of  labour, complete as per specifications.

Painting   with   synthetic   enamel   paint   of   approved   brand   and manufacture  to  give  an  even  shade  :Two  coats  on  new  work   after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.
Repairs to existing aluminium partition including Glass,board, lock, handle, beading etc cost of all material,labour, complete as per specifications.

French  spirit  polishing  :One  coats  on  old  work  to  give  an  even  surface including preparing the surface after thorougly cleaning oil, grease, dirt and foreign matter, sand papering smooth , cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Providing  and  fixing  on  wall  face  unplasticised  Rigid  PVC  rain  water pipes of 150mm dia conforming to IS : 13592 Type A, including jointing with seal ring conforming to IS : 5382, leaving 10 mm gap for thermal expansion, (i) Single socketed pipes.

Wall  painting  with  premium  acrylic  emulsion  paint  of  interior  grade, having VOC (Volatile   Organic Compound ) content less than 50 g/L of approved  brand  and  manufacture,  including  applying  additional   coats wherever  required  to  achieve  even  shade  and colour. Two coats as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge.

Providing, mixing and applying Repair Mortar having binder (Cement/epoxy), aggregates (Sand/water and perormance-enhancing additives like polymers (SBR/Cellulore) fibers silica fume etc. ( for repairing concrete surfaces identified concrete surface shall throughly roughened by chipping followed by water jet cleaning, surface shall be primed with acrylic bonding agent prior to application of mortar in layer of 12mm: The mortar shall be air used. ,including cost of all materials, labour and usage charges of machinery complete as per the direction of engineer incharge of work. 50 mm average thickness in 3 layers.

Providing and applying two coats of approved brand and shade Apex Ultima paint on External wall surface after throughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and other foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, including the cost of materials, labour charges complete as per the specifications and the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the Work.
